# Game Development Toolkit adapter

Source: https://github.com/dbattaglia0823-design/Game-Dev-Toolkit

Copied from upstream tree `305502362b26c6e3e834f3d2bccc4759b6aabd2e`:
`godot/layout-kit/ui_layout.gd`. The original compatible Godot 4 adapter is
retained; REDLINE-specific behavior is in its `ToolkitVehicleScreen` subclass.
The original schema and validator are also copied into `tools/toolkit_validation/`
for offline verification. All copies are covered by the adjacent MIT license.

See `tools/TOOLKIT_UI_INTEGRATION.md` for action/data mappings, responsive
adaptation, intentional validator warnings and test instructions.
